title: The Scroll and the Lamb

questions.question: Then I saw in the right hand of him who was seated on the throne a ____ written within and on the back, sealed with seven seals.
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:1 (ESV): "Then I saw in the right hand of him who was seated on the throne a scroll written within and on the back, sealed with seven seals."

questions.question: And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, "Who is ____ to open the scroll and break its seals?"
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:2 (ESV): "And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, 'Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?'"

questions.question: And no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or to ____ into it,
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:3 (ESV): "And no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or to look into it,"

questions.question: and I began to weep loudly because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or to look into it. And one of the ____ said to me, "Weep no more;"
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:4-5 (ESV): "and I began to weep loudly because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or to look into it. And one of the elders said to me, 'Weep no more; behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has conquered, so that he can open the scroll and its seven seals.'"

questions.question: "...behold, the ____ of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has conquered, so that he can open the scroll and its seven seals."
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:5 (ESV): "...behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has conquered, so that he can open the scroll and its seven seals."

questions.question: And between the throne and the four living creatures and among the elders I saw a ____ standing, as though it had been slain, with seven horns and with seven eyes...
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:6 (ESV): "And between the throne and the four living creatures and among the elders I saw a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, with seven horns and with seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God sent out into all the earth."

questions.question: The Lamb had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven ____ of God sent out into all the earth.
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:6 (ESV): "And between the throne and the four living creatures and among the elders I saw a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, with seven horns and with seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God sent out into all the earth."

questions.question: And he went and took the scroll from the ____ hand of him who was seated on the throne.
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:7 (ESV): "And he went and took the scroll from the right hand of him who was seated on the throne."

questions.question: And when he had taken the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each holding a harp, and golden bowls full of ____, which are the prayers of the saints.
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:8 (ESV): "And when he had taken the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each holding a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints."

questions.question: And they sang a new song, saying, "Worthy are you to take the scroll and to open its seals, for you were ____, and by your blood you ransomed people for God"
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:9 (ESV): "And they sang a new song, saying, 'Worthy are you to take the scroll and to open its seals, for you were slain, and by your blood you ransomed people for God from every tribe and language and people and nation,'"

questions.question: "...from every tribe and ____ and people and nation, and you have made them a kingdom and priests to our God, and they shall reign on the earth."
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:9-10 (ESV): "'...from every tribe and language and people and nation, and you have made them a kingdom and priests to our God, and they shall reign on the earth.'"

questions.question: Then I looked, and I heard around the throne and the living creatures and the elders the voice of many ____, numbering myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands,
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:11 (ESV): "Then I looked, and I heard around the throne and the living creatures and the elders the voice of many angels, numbering myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands,"

questions.question: saying with a loud voice, "Worthy is the Lamb who was slain, to receive ____ and wealth and wisdom and might and honor and glory and blessing!"
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:12 (ESV): "saying with a loud voice, 'Worthy is the Lamb who was slain, to receive power and wealth and wisdom and might and honor and glory and blessing!'"

questions.question: And I heard every ____ in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea, and all that is in them, saying,
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:13 (ESV): "And I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea, and all that is in them, saying, 'To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be blessing and honor and glory and might forever and ever!'"

questions.question: "To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be blessing and honor and glory and ____ forever and ever!"
questions.explanation: Revelation 5:13 (ESV): "'...To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be blessing and honor and glory and might forever and ever!'"

key_verse_text: saying with a loud voice, "Worthy is the Lamb who was slain, to receive power and wealth and wisdom and might and honor and glory and blessing!"
